description: Upcoming Pirate Skills events, soonest first by date, with a link to each event page (a Forge session links the Forge page, where the seat is sold) and, for a signed-in person, whether they are registered. A Forge cohort appears only as its start – the first session of its Build or Grow part; its weekly sessions are never listed here. Present them in that date order, and give each event its one line from `about` – what it is and who it is for – so the person knows what they are looking at (an event without `about` is a one-off; its subtitle says it). When the person asks about their own Forge cohort or its sessions, use my_forge_sessions instead. `cadence` is how often that event's format meets – weekly only for the Forge (every week of a six-week phase), monthly for Vibe Coding Cologne, the Pirate Lab and AI Compass, quarterly for the Vibe Hackathon, one-off otherwise; give each event its own and never carry one event's cadence over to the others. `when` is the day and time to quote, in Berlin time; `startsAt`/`endsAt` are the same moment in UTC, for working with, never for quoting (the Captain's copy leaves them out, and gives a subtitle an earlier event already carried as null).

type.description: Filter by event type label, e.g. "Pirate Lab" or "Vibe Coding Cologne". Omit for all.
